d.html:
Love,

Happy anniversary to us.



I may not always know the perfect words to say, but I want you to know how grateful I am for every moment we’ve shared. From the simplest conversations to the memories that make me smile whenever I think about them, having you in my life has been something truly special.



Thank you for being someone I can laugh with, talk to, and simply be myself around. I hope we continue to make beautiful memories together, support each other through everything, and choose each other every day.



No matter how much time passes, I hope you always remember how much you mean to me. Here’s to us, to everything we’ve been through, and to all the moments still waiting for us.



Forever yours.

You
